verdict.rationale: Deel documents a public REST API with OAuth2 app authorization for accessing user accounts, webhooks, and an isolated sandbox. That supports building integrations around Deel payroll and contract data. Nothing in the evidence describes a white-label or embedded payroll offering or a dedicated partner program that lets a developer run payroll under their own brand. Missing for 10: white-label/embedded payroll product, partner API program docs, payroll-run endpoints, branding control, independent corroboration.
